newsitem.title: USA: Hilton wins Missouri gaming license.
newsitem.headline: Hilton wins Missouri gaming license.

text.p: Hilton Hotels Corp said Friday the Missouri Gaming Commission has granted Hilton a license to operate its $115 million Flamingo Casino-Kansas City, clearing the way for Hilton to open the riverboat gambling operation today.
Hilton had planned on opening begin operations at the Flamingo this past summer, but hit a snag when regulators launched an inquiry into a grant made by Hilton to a local nonprofit organization.

Last week in a hearing before the gaming commission, Hilton chief executive Stephen Bollenbach acknowledged the company had made errors in judgment and announced the resignation of three top officials.
The commission, then voted to recommend Hilton as suitable for a license. Thursday, regulators made their final inspection of the riverboat.
"We are delighted to have completed this process and now look forward to getting on with the important work of generating revenues," Stephen Bollenbach, Hilton chief executive, said in a statement.
The Flamingo-Kansas City employs roughly 900 people and the boat contains 30,000 square feet of casino space, over 1,000 slots and 60 table games.
By mid-1997, Hilton expects to have a 260-room Hilton Garden Inn operating at the riverboat complex.
